issues.reason: Names and casing restricts the capitalized-common-noun default to singular collectives and routes a capitalized PLURAL kind-word label ('the Wrens') to a Name-only individual with no GroupOf and no per-member kind from the label word, so (GroupOf sk_keeper_1 keeper) invents a member type the rule bars and the mandatory Name atom is missing.

With the referent a Name-only individual there is no group to range over, so the (PartOf $x sk_keeper_1) rule distributes the tolerating to members the sentence never posits — an over-assertion that falls with the group reading.

new_gaps: the plural-label rule's qualifier 'referring as a name' has no stated test: casing is the only mechanical cue, and nothing says when a capitalized plural kind-word ('the Keepers') may instead be read as an ordinary definite plural
defect_summary: Issue 0: one symbol with (Name keepers "Keepers") and no GroupOf, the event as (Member sk_tolerate_1 tolerate) (Agent sk_tolerate_1 keepers) (Theme sk_tolerate_1 sky_cat); issue 1: no per-member distribution rule at all, since a Name-only individual has no posited members.
notes: The sky_cat genus with its noun modifier unexposed, Agent by the progressive test, the bare kind filler for the non-specific plural object, and the absent status atom on the habitual are all correct.
